article.title_es: Advent Lutheran Church: despensa de alimentos y comedor en Manhattan
article.title_en: Advent Lutheran Church: food pantry and soup kitchen in Manhattan
article.summary_es: Advent Lutheran Church es una despensa de alimentos y un comedor de sopa en Manhattan, incluido en el mapa Food Help NYC de la Ciudad. La despensa y el comedor abren sábados distintos cada mes.
article.summary_en: Advent Lutheran Church is a food pantry and soup kitchen in Manhattan listed on the City's Food Help NYC map. The pantry and soup kitchen open on different Saturdays each month.
how_they_help_es: Despensa de alimentos abierta el 1.er y 3.er sábado del mes, de 10am a 12pm.
Comedor de sopa abierto el 2.º y 4.º sábado del mes, de 12pm a 1pm.
Ubicado en 2504 Broadway, New York, NY 10025.
Los alimentos que entregan y los requisitos no aparecen en la lista; pregunte cuando llame.
how_they_help_en: Food pantry open on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, 10am-12pm.
Soup kitchen open on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month, 12pm-1pm.
Located at 2504 Broadway, New York, NY 10025.
What food is given and any requirements are not listed, so ask when you call.
visit_tips_es: Revise bien el calendario: la despensa y el comedor abren sábados distintos del mes.
Llame al (212) 665-2504 antes de ir para confirmar el horario.
Los horarios indicados son solo los sábados; no se indican horarios entre semana.
visit_tips_en: Check the calendar carefully: the pantry and soup kitchen open on different Saturdays of the month.
Call (212) 665-2504 ahead to confirm the schedule before you go.
Hours listed are Saturdays only; no weekday hours are listed.

faq_es.a: Solo el 1.er y 3.er sábado del mes, de 10am a 12pm.
Solo el 2.º y 4.º sábado del mes, de 12pm a 1pm.
No aparece en la lista. Llame al (212) 665-2504 para preguntar antes de visitar.

faq_en.q: When is the food pantry open?
faq_en.a: Only on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, from 10am to 12pm.

faq_en.q: When is the soup kitchen open?
faq_en.a: Only on the 2nd and 4th Saturday of the month, from 12pm to 1pm.

faq_en.q: Do I need to bring anything or sign up?
faq_en.a: That is not listed. Call (212) 665-2504 to ask before you visit.
